decisions.reason: As an accelerator program sits furthest from the firm's core machinery and recycling-plant business, it is the most likely offering to be discontinued as resources are focused on scalable technology products.

Although more commercially uncertain than the plant products, it has been presented as a strategic flagship and fits the firm's innovation-driven growth agenda, so management would likely continue backing it.
This decontamination plant is close to the established offer, prominently marketed, and positioned as a flagship, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
A mobile mechanical recycling plant strongly matches the firm's decentralized modular recycling strategy and core manufacturing capabilities, so it is very likely to remain on the market.
